summary.zh-CN: 修复 Linux 上原生 Service App 安装后无法执行的问题。
summary.en-US: Fixes native Service Apps losing execute permission after installation on Linux.

title.zh-CN: 原生 Service 执行权限

body.zh-CN: 安装器会让当前平台已验证的包内 Service 命令保持可执行，同时继续把安装目录冻结为只读。
body.en-US: Installation keeps the validated in-package Service command executable for the current platform while leaving the installed directory read-only.

title.zh-CN: 现有 App 无需改 manifest

body.zh-CN: 系统命令、绝对路径和普通资源文件保持原有行为；重新安装 App 即可应用修复。
body.en-US: System commands, absolute paths, and ordinary resources keep their existing behavior; reinstall the App to apply the fix.
